review_mode: Independent architecture/backend/security/configuration-transaction review of actual27-file isolated candidate and existing source dependencies. No compilation, tests, SQL, model calls or candidate edits.

blocking_findings.issue: Protected scope discovery silently treats ASCII-case variants and same-name non-table objects as no reservation. SQLite identifiers are case-insensitive but sqlite_master name equality is case-sensitive.
blocking_findings.trigger: Create CLASSROOM_SCOPE_RESERVATIONS with a pilot row for an inheriting student, or expose that reserved name as a view. Change global ladder. count=0 returns an empty protection set, allowing configuration/cards mutation instead of rejecting protected/unknown scope.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Lookup owned name with ASCII case-insensitive semantics across object types; explicitly reject noncanonical name/non-table or malformed owned schema rather than treating it as absence. Preserve no-new-migration scope.
blocking_findings.regression: Real SQLite uppercase table with pilot/no-card scope and same-name view; assert whole mutation rejected with unchanged config/card/revision/audit. Canonical legacy/no-table compatibility positive cases.

blocking_findings.issue: Unknown write delivery does not enter a reconciliation-required state. catch displays a suggestion but retains data/loadedIdentity; finally clears busy, so save/delete are immediately available using pre-write data. Successful POST followed by failing GET has the same issue.
blocking_findings.trigger: Let server commit set/delete, then lose its response, or return successful POST then fail effective GET. User can immediately submit again without observing effective value/revision, contrary to approved unknown-delivery contract.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Keep the edit draft but latch write-disabled reconciliation state for delivery-unknown and committed-read-failed outcomes; only a successful same-identity effective read clears it. Distinguish known validation rejection so retryable edits need not be discarded. Keep refresh_pending behavior and no automatic mutation retry.
blocking_findings.regression: Node state test plus actual UI delayed/committed-response-loss and post-success GET failure: retain draft, disable save/delete, no extra request on click, successful manual read restores eligibility.

blocking_findings.issue: New strict configuration decoder rejects unknown fields but accepts duplicate and case-alias JSON keys; encoding/json uses last value and case-insensitive struct matching, so ambiguous target/scope/value silently selects a mutation.
blocking_findings.trigger: POST raw JSON with duplicate scope/studentId or scope plus Scope containing different values. Request can become global or target another student despite an earlier contradictory field. DELETE likewise accepts conflicting studentId keys.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Reject duplicate/case-alias known fields and null required fields before applying mutations, using a narrow existing strict JSON validator or explicit token/schema check; retain current body cap and fixed safe errors.
blocking_findings.regression: Raw-body HTTP tests for exact duplicate and mixed-case duplicate scope/studentId/key/value and null targets, assert400 and zero config/revision/card/audit writes. Ordinary canonical request remains accepted.

verified_invariants: WithAtomicWrite reuses pinned atomicConnection and acquires SQLite writer before config/card reads; nested ownership remains governed by existing helper.

Effective before/after ladder comparison is per student and includes goalMode derivation; global protected no-card IDs are included in canonical-table case. Only ladder_step is updated; no due/status overwrite or automatic step promotion.
SQLite config/cards/revisions/fixed audit share one transaction; live Reload occurs after commit under agentWriteMu; refresh failure returns committed plus refresh_pending.
Fresh persistent reads do not fall back to live cache; placement reset+plan now share fresh work while already-saved draft remains separately committed.
Memory ChangeConfig follows agentWriteMu then App.mu then cfg/scheduler/memory private clones; mixed unsupported backend fails before writes.
Persistent tool/feedback/completion factories use writer-first safe owner; inner work avoids nested transaction. Current System Agent configuration key whitelist is unchanged.
Paired live scheduling consumers reject non-work calls; memory completion ConfigWorkView retains original pending-settlement and finished metadata ownership.
Hub fetches fresh new-class config outside Hub.mu and double-checks Room existence; persisted snapshots remain authoritative for restore.
Effective DTO distinguishes explicit student/global versus goal-derived default, supplies both revisions and delete fallback; HTTP routes remain admin-only.
Pilot component default migration/App routes are not enabled by this slice.

acceptance_gaps.description: Handoff correctly states no compile/test execution.14 new Go top-level cases and one authored E2E do not yet cover the full approved matrix. No passing result claimed.

Add actual fresh-work consumer cases after Reload failure (new Hub entry, placement finish, completion next lesson), cross-App scheduling using changed ladder, old-room frozen config retention, and memory completion/config concurrency. Current refresh test only calls FreshConfigSnapshot/EffectiveConfiguration.

Add config persistence/audit failure, cancellation, no-op delete zero writes/revisions/audit, mixed backend rejection, same-length effective changes and complete goalMode set/delete inheritance cases; existing card-failure/deferred-COMMIT/two-App tests are useful but not substitutes.

The sole ladder E2E requires preseeded accounts, has no dedicated runnable acceptance configuration, no second-student/card-state isolation, restart persistence or real SQL failure recovery. Handoff already declares these missing; do not call it complete UI acceptance.

nonblocking_boundaries: ConfigWorkView is an exported trusted-internal seam, not runtime authorization; current production memory-completion call owns agentWriteMu. Do not expose it as an unguarded API or claim arbitrary caller isolation.
configMutation capability is assembled but no current sensitive Agent tool consumes it; unchanged System whitelist means this is not new Agent ladder autonomy.
Strict schema protection correction is a conservative read guard, not authorization to integrate Pilot products or migrate default22-table schema.
All findings concern isolated candidate only; approved formal startup/repeat/G1/WAIT39 candidate is unchanged.
